theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) combined with Retro-Futurism/Terminal Look
theme_and_archetype.description: A dark, highly structured, brutalist UI designed for developers. Focuses on data density, precise typography, and functional colors. No soft shadows, no gradients. Sharp edges.

typography.heading_strategy: Tight tracking, semi-bold to bold weights, explicit text sizing up to text-2xl max (dense tool).
typography.body_strategy: Small, readable, low-contrast neutral grays for labels, high-contrast white for data.

layout_and_grids.spacing: Tight padding (p-2, p-4) to maximize data density.

structure.container: h-screen w-full flex overflow-hidden bg-[#050505] text-[#FAFAFA]
structure.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-[#27272A] flex flex-col h-full
structure.top_bar: h-14 border-b border-[#27272A] flex items-center px-4 gap-4
structure.request_panel: flex-1 border-r border-[#27272A] flex flex-col h-full

components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none), solid high-contrast text, 1px borders. Primary CTA is solid #FAFAFA text #000000.
components.inputs: Flat, monospace for URL and JSON, dark background, 1px border. Focus state is a white 1px border.
components.tabs: Minimalist underline style. Active state has 1px white bottom border and bright text. Inactive is muted gray.
components.json_editor: Fully monospace text area, syntax highlighted (if possible), dark background, distinct line numbers.
components.badges: Used for HTTP methods and status codes. Small, uppercase, tracking-[0.1em], colored text on subtle tinted background (10% opacity).
components.terminology_panel: A dedicated section in the response view that scans JSON keys. Displays warnings when it detects 'master', 'franchise', 'central' instead of standard POS terms.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts to expose the skeleton of the UI.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders and background contrast for depth.

motion.hover_states: Subtle background lightening (bg-zinc-900) or border color change. No scaling/bouncing.
motion.transitions: Instant or very fast (75ms). Developer tools need to feel snappy.
motion.focus: Clear 1px solid white border outline for accessibility.

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons in 'bold' or 'regular' weight for clear, technical aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Use tinted grays (not pure #808080).
accessibility.focus_management: All interactive inputs must have visible focus rings (ring-1 ring-white/50).

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: api-list-item, method-selector, url-input, send-request-btn, response-status, json-viewer, terminology-warning.

media_and_images.instructions: No images are needed. This is a pure data/API console.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required icon library: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Install required font families (e.g., via Google Fonts in index.html or Fontsource): IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono.
Strip Shadcn default border-radius globally (set --radius: 0 in global CSS).
Do not use card components with soft shadows. Build panels using raw divs with explicit 1px borders (border border-border).

Implement a robust 'Terminology Mapping' validation function that checks the response JSON keys for forbidden terms (e.g. 'franchise' instead of 'outlet') and highlights them in a dedicated 'Warnings' panel.
Ensure the JSON payload and response viewers use a <textarea> or code editor component set to font-mono (JetBrains Mono).
Structure the layout exactly as a desktop IDE: fixed sidebar, scrollable inner panes, no main page vertical scrolling.
